summary.text: Jason Shedlock is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 120, in the November 3, 2026 general election. In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a labor leader and community activist.

paragraphs.text: Jason Shedlock said in a Ballotpedia survey that he comes from a long line of blue-collar workers and that he has spent his working life as a labor leader and community activist.
He said his campaign is about South Portland and that he supports labor unions, wages and benefits as part of addressing the affordability crisis.

Shedlock also named housing costs, seniors' ability to age in place, health care decision-making, and full funding for public schools among his concerns, and described health care and housing as human rights.
